arStrings.szText: Tyrael has entrusted me with the Soulstones. When I asked him why, he told me, “The stones will show you.”
I took them to my chambers, hoping for even the smallest sign. But I was met with dark nothingness.
I went to bed, frustrated, when a thought crossed my mind: They are “nothing” to my eyes, as I am bound by the rules of this world.
These stones require one to see beyond what is “there" to achieve true understanding.
